protocol: Written before the gate was run and before src/number_gate.py, docs/method.md, README.md, tests/, runs/, results/ or other paper/ folders were opened. Inputs read: prompts/note_rules.txt, prompts/extract_system.txt, prompts/columns_guide.txt and the seven assigned tables. No model API calls.

preregistered_metrics.numeric_mentions: digit-form registered mentions (is_word=0); word-form counts reported separately
preregistered_metrics.alignment: a truth mention is matched to the gate record whose character span overlaps it on the same note line; if the gate reports no spans, match by line and normalised numeric value in reading order
preregistered_metrics.correct_not_extracted: C labelled Skipped or with no matching gate record
preregistered_metrics.wrong_not_extracted: W labelled Skipped or with no matching gate record (reported separately; not caught)
preregistered_metrics.misses_by_design: misses whose cited value is a real cell of another row or period, or coincides with an unrelated cell or derivation, as documented as a limit in docs/method.md section 7
preregistered_metrics.non_measures_skipped: N or CNT labelled Skipped or with no matching gate record
preregistered_metrics.non_measures_supported: N or CNT labelled Supported_* (reported, not an error)
